# Synthetic PNG intake smoke fixture

The JSON and image contain fictional test material, no secrets and no actual article. The fixed source URL is a one-shot journal key: do not retry an uncertain send or reuse it as real content. The item is deliberately marked ready solely to exercise the existing gallery-submit validation. It must never be approved to a public channel. Sending it requires an explicit action, an intake secret and a separately configured review Worker; tests only preview it offline.
